1	# HR Plan: Scale Agent Workforce 30 → 54 in 6 Weeks
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Today the Boldteq Software Factory runs **30 agents** across 6 departments. Three are critically overloaded (Koda, Quill, Rex), and three core capability blocks are missing: **stack-specific engineering depth** (3 stacks share one Koda), **deep design specialization** (only Vega + Pixel for all UI/UX), and **CRO mastery** (no agent owns conversion strategy).
6	
7	The factory's mission requires bulk SaaS shipping across 3 stacks: **Next.js + Supabase + Railway**, **Shopify Native**, and **Shopify External**. Every project also needs **Resend transactional email** and **40%+ conversion** marketing/ecom pages — neither of which has a deep specialist today.
8	
9	This plan locks in **24 net-new specialist agents** + **4 decompositions of overloaded agents**, executed in **6 weekly cohorts of 5 agents** under a strengthened HR team. Every new agent is narrow-by-design to maximize per-task token efficiency: each agent loads only the memory/skills it owns, never the full org's knowledge base.
10	
11	**Boldteq B2B agency operations are deferred to v2** (post 5 paying clients on boldteq.com). All 24 new hires serve internal product velocity first.
12	
13	**End-state:** 54 agents, every routing decision touches the most-specialized agent, token waste drops ~40%.
